read.thesis: India standalone EBITDA Rs 17,257/t on 16% volume growth and Rs 10,315 cr EBITDA, but UK deliveries ~0.4 Mt vs 0.6 Mt needed for breakeven and Netherlands DSP restart lifted EBITDA to EUR 72 mn.

capex.quote: The 4.8 MTPA expansion project has entered the execution phase and remains on track for commissioning in FY2030.

triggers.label: UK flat steel inventory ~865 kt, ~60% above normal
triggers.quote: flat steel inventories in the UK rising to roughly 865 kt by September, nearly 60% above normal levels

triggers.label: UK breakeven pushed to 4Q FY27
triggers.quote: our own expectation is that we will come close to breakeven in 4Q, when most of the stocks would have got flushed out

triggers.label: Netherlands EBITDA EUR 4 mn → EUR 72 mn
triggers.quote: EBITDA increased from €4 million in the first quarter to €72 million in the second quarter

triggers.label: Coking coal benchmark +12% QoQ
triggers.quote: benchmark coking coal prices increased by 12% between July and September

guidance.quote: we expect the realisations to be about Rs. 3,500 to 3,600 per ton higher in 3Q compared to 2Q

for the full year we should target more around 6.5 MTPA and deliveries around 6 MTPA
